paragraphs.text: Lucky Luke (also known as Daisy Town in many of the re-releases) is a 1971 Franco-Belgian film based upon the comic book character Lucky Luke and making it his first animated appearance. The film was directed by the original creators of the comics (René Goscinny and Morris) and was co-produced between Belvision Studios (Brussels) and Dargaud Films (Paris). A Lucky Luke comic based on the film, with the title Daisy Town was released in 1982, drawn by Pascal Dabère.
